title: Number of Prints in French Libraries, sorted by decade
List of composers with an aggregate of the sigla where their sources are held
query:
PREFIX rism: <https://rism.online/api/v1#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX relators: <http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/relators/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT
    ?composer
    ?composer_id
    (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?siglum; SEPARATOR=",") AS ?sigla)
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ?source) AS ?source_count)
WHERE {
    ?source a rism:Source ;
    dcterms:creator ?creator ;
    rism:holdings/rism:hasHolding ?exemplar .

    ?creator dcterms:relation ?composer_id ;
               rism:hasRole relators:cre .

    # Filter out the Anonymous person.
    FILTER(?composer_id != <https://rism.online/people/30004985>)

    ?composer_id rdfs:label ?composer .
    FILTER(LANG(?composer) = "none")

    ?exemplar rism:hasHoldingInstitution/rism:hasSiglum ?siglum .
}
GROUP BY ?composer ?composer_id
ORDER BY DESC(?source_count)

title: People in RISM listed as a dedicatee, by unique institution
List of the sources with composer, title, dates and publication place
Analysis of key signatures and their relationship to time signatures
query:
PREFIX rism: <https://rism.online/api/v1#>

SELECT
    ?keysig
    ?meterClass
    (COUNT(?incipit) AS ?count)
WHERE {
    VALUES (?timesig ?meterClass) {
      ("c"    "binary")
      ("c/"   "binary")
      ("4/4"  "binary")
      ("2/4"  "binary")
      ("2/2"  "binary")
      ("4/2"  "binary")
      ("3/4"  "ternary")
      ("3/8"  "ternary")
      ("3/2"  "ternary")
      ("6/8"  "compound")
      ("12/8" "compound")
      ("6/4"  "compound")
    }

    ?incipit a rism:Incipit ;
             rism:hasPAEKeysig ?keysig ;
             rism:hasPAETimesig ?timesig .
}
GROUP BY ?keysig ?meterClass
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

title: List of people as dedicatees by number of sources
query:
PREFIX rism: <https://rism.online/api/v1#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX relators: <http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/relators/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT
    ?person
    (SAMPLE(?name) AS ?personName)
    (COUNT(DISTINCT ?source) AS ?dedicateeCount)
WHERE {
    ?source rism:relationships/rism:hasRelationship ?rel .

    ?rel rism:hasRole relators:dte ;
         dcterms:relation ?person .

    ?person rdfs:label ?name .
    FILTER(LANG(?name) = "none")
}
GROUP BY ?person
ORDER BY DESC(?dedicateeCount)

title: List of people in RISM with portraits in Wikidata
Performers listed in sources in the Dresden State Library that lack a first name (Credit: Alfredo Vitolo)
query:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rism: <https://rism.online/api/v1#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX relators: <http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/relators/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT
    ?person
    (?pName AS ?performer_name)
WHERE {
    # 1. Official ID of the target library (example: Sächsische Landesbibliothek, Dresden)
    BIND(<https://rism.online/institutions/30000042> AS ?library)
    # 2. Link sources to the physical copies held by the specified library
    ?source a rism:Source ;
            rism:holdings/rism:hasHolding ?copy .
    ?copy rism:hasHoldingInstitution ?library .
    # 3. Retrieve relationships (either direct or nested within material groups)
    {
      ?source rism:relationships/rism:hasRelationship ?rel .
    }
    UNION
    {
      ?source rism:materialGroups/rism:hasMaterialGroup/
              rism:relationships/rism:hasRelationship ?rel .
    }
    # 4. Filter strictly by the related person and the 'prf' (Performer) role.
    # For the complete list of relation codes, visit: https://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/relators.html
    # NOTE: Not all Library of Congress codes are used in RISM.
    # Common active codes include: dte (Dedicatee), lbt (Librettist), fmo (Former owner) or scr (Scribe).
    ?rel dcterms:relation ?person ;
         rism:hasRole relators:prf .
    # 5. Fetch the person's name and apply language tag filtering
    ?person a rism:Person ;
            rdfs:label ?pName .
    FILTER(LANG(?pName) = "none")

    # EXCLUSION CRITERION: Excludes records without a standard "Surname, Name" structure.
    # To include all names, simply add a # at the beginning of the next line to comment it out:
    FILTER(!CONTAINS(STR(?pName), ", "))
}
ORDER BY ?performer_name
LIMIT 1000
